title: Beyond the Chatbox
text:
Overview
Welcome to Beyond the Chatbox: LLM Coding Agents for Research (September 2026).
This workshop provides a practical introduction to using large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows in scientific research, computational reproducibility, and data analysis.

title: Beyond the Chatbox

Workshop Information

Date: September 2026
Topic: LLM Coding and Research Agents
Target Audience: Researchers, data analysts, and computational scientists
